purpose: scientific exploration of matched monthly dynamics before discarding the monthly representation

source.scope: all Chapter 72 iron and steel records
source.aggregation: flow x CN8 x partner country x month

temporal_invariant.block_measure: N training months x N target months

games.window_policy: all contiguous windows with room for the immediately following equal-length target block
games.Z_post: prequential within each target block; month t can affect only later months in the same game
games.year_end: December retained as an explicit YEAR_END regime

targets.participation: cell presence in each target month
targets.weight_kg: monthly physical mass conditional on presence and positive mass
targets.statistical_unit_value: statistical value divided by mass conditional on positive numerator and denominator

models.weights: fresh equal-prior expert weights learned only from the current game's same-unit history
models.short_history: uniform expert weights when fewer than four months leave no internal rolling fold

causal_state_before_execution.december_rule: all predictions from every game involving December must be written and hashed before opening the archive

storage.durable_local_outputs: normalized monthly aggregates, December prediction freeze, results, sequence and manifest only
